<span dir="ltr">Sample of Blissymbols</span><div><div>
{| cellspacing="0"
|-
| <div dir="ltr">
Here I show a brief sample of "[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blissymbols Blissymbols]", the writing system devised by Charles K. Bliss in the 1940's.

The symbols here follow the proportions set by Michael Everson in his 1998 [http://std.dkuug.dk/JTC1/SC2/WG2/docs/n1866.pdf encoding proposal], yet I have slightly modified a small number of symbols so they fit a regular frame of 25 x 25 pixels.

<br /><br />Last modified on 2 July 2012. Available under the [http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/deed Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike License]. About [https://sites.google.com/site/onxavigotsky/ the author]. <br /><br />
